groups.operation: Call cJSON_Minify on a whole-input single-line comment.
groups.condition: The input body contains only a // comment followed by a newline and NUL, and the harness requires parsing to succeed before minification.
groups.capability: cJSON_Minify can reduce the comment-only body to an empty string.
groups.consequence: The harness returns after parsing fails, so it never calls cJSON_Minify or produces the empty-string result.
groups.equivalence_reason: Both candidates describe the same minification operation, comment-only input, parse-success gate, and blocked result.
